# update esbuild

Move the `esbuild` pin in the Go toolset from the 0.8 line to v0.9.2; the release notes the author collected:

- https://github.com/evanw/esbuild/releases/tag/v0.8.57
- https://github.com/evanw/esbuild/releases/tag/v0.9.0
- https://github.com/evanw/esbuild/releases/tag/v0.9.1
- https://github.com/evanw/esbuild/releases/tag/v0.9.2

`esbuild` is a JS bundler kept in the Go toolset, installed by `go generate` over [tools.go](../../toolset/tools.go) from the version pinned in [toolset/go.mod](../../toolset/go.mod); the bump is a change of that pin. This is the only bump in the series carrying the `help wanted` label; the reason is not recorded.
